# The Five Bells

> A traditional pub at 155 New Cross Road in New Cross, South East London, with live sport on screens around the pub, a pool table, free guest Wi-Fi, a broad drinks selection and space for group celebrations. Food is not currently served.

- Address: 155 New Cross Road, London SE14 5DJ, United Kingdom
- Website: https://www.five-bells.uk
- Email: info@five-bells.uk
- Opening hours (UK time): Monday to Thursday midday to 11 pm; Friday to Saturday midday to 1:30 am; Sunday midday to 10:30 pm
- Food: not currently served
- Facilities: Live sport, Free guest Wi-Fi, Pool table, Music and entertainment, Drinks selection, Venue hire, Friendly atmosphere

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is The Five Bells?
The Five Bells is at 155 New Cross Road, London SE14 5DJ.

### What are the opening hours?
The pub is open from midday to 11 pm Monday to Thursday, from midday to 1:30 am Friday to Saturday and from midday to 10:30 pm on Sunday.

### Does The Five Bells show live football?
Yes, The Five Bells has screens around the pub for live sport, including TNT Sports and Sky Sports. Which matches we show depends on the broadcasts available.

### Can I book The Five Bells for a birthday party?
You can enquire about birthdays, group celebrations and venue hire. Availability and arrangements are confirmed directly with the pub.

### Can I reserve tables for a group?
You can enquire about group seating and reserved tables, subject to availability.

### Does The Five Bells have a pool table?
Yes, the pub has a pool table.

### Does The Five Bells offer free Wi-Fi?
Yes, free guest Wi-Fi is available.

### Does The Five Bells serve food?
Food is not currently served at The Five Bells.

### Does The Five Bells have live music?
Music and entertainment are on for selected dates. Get in touch with the pub to hear about upcoming events.

### What drinks does The Five Bells serve?
The pub serves a selection of beers, ciders, wines, spirits and soft drinks. Availability may vary.

### How do I get to The Five Bells?
The pub is on New Cross Road in South East London. Use the Get Directions link to open its location in Google Maps.

### What are some interesting historical facts about The Five Bells?
The Five Bells is more than just a local pub. It’s a historic, Grade II listed Victorian public house that has been part of New Cross for generations.

The pub also has a fascinating literary connection. Charles Dickens wrote *Our Mutual Friend* at The Five Bells while lodging nearby.

It’s equally well known for its connection to Millwall Football Club supporters, having served as a popular pre-match gathering place for generations. Photographs from 1988, preserved by the London Picture Archive, even capture Millwall fans gathering at the pub.

From Victorian literary history to football traditions, The Five Bells has a rich heritage and remains an important part of the New Cross community.
